notes: Machine-readable twin of INSTALL.md. Keep both in sync. status values: documented = commands taken from the repo README; unverified = never run on that host or, when a host lists routes, on that route; verified = run on the named route and operating system; planned = not available yet; published = the release asset exists. published is not the same as verified on a host. When routes is present, each route has its own status; do not read the host status as covering every route. Release assets (the plugin archive, the .mcpb, and the add-on) are built by .github/workflows/release.yml. Use the plugin archive only when the latest release version is the same or newer than version in .codex-plugin/plugin.json on main and the zip is listed; otherwise use the source route and say so. first_run and keys describe the setup tools: setup_status (what works now) and open_setup (the masked key page); both are in the runtime bundle, the .mcpb and a source build.

after_install.description: Source route only. dist/ folders are build output and are not in git, so every route that installs from the repository must build once. Skip this when runtime/bundle/index.mjs exists (release archive).
after_install.locate_plugin_root: The folder that contains scripts/bootstrap.mjs and .mcp.json. Search for it; do not guess.

first_run.description: Owns first-run: detects the app, follows the route for it in this file, calls setup_status, opens the key page only when a key is wanted, re-checks, and ends with a tiny real search.
first_run.status_shape: Three groups, works_now, needs_you and optional, each item with Chinese and English text. rendered.zh and rendered.en hold the text to show. Chinese is the default.
first_run.smoke_test_runner: search_helper.run from setup_status (run.posix or run.powershell) replaces uv run; install_search_helper downloads the pinned helper when setup_status lists search under Needs you
first_run.smoke_test: uv run literature-research/scripts/literature_search.py review --question "setup check" --pubmed-query "CRISPR base editing[Title]" --limit 3 --top-n 3 --output <private-temp>/ai4s-setup-check
first_run.finish: After the end check, mention key onboarding once and offer the Zotero add-on at https://github.com/Frankkk1912/ai4s-literature-workbench/releases/latest/download/literature-metrics.xpi (install by hand: Tools, Add-ons, gear menu, Install Add-on From File, restart Zotero). List only missing keys using setup_status.diagnostics.zotero_key_present, pubmed_key_present and easyscholar_key_present; never print diagnostics or key values. If all three are set, say: All keys are set; ask for the key page any time to change one. This counts as mentioning key onboarding. Do not guess when setup_status is unavailable. Ask once about missing keys and the add-on, not keys already set. The partition columns need an EasyScholar key to fill in.

keys.rule: Never in chat and never in a command or tool argument. Optional: search needs no key. Ask only for a key that unlocks something the user asked for.
keys.tool_arguments: keys: the keys to offer, in order (omit for all three); language: zh or en
keys.tool_result: opened (whether the browser was launched), url (no code in it), keys, message; fallback_code only when opened is false
keys.if_browser_not_opened: Give the user url and fallback_code to type into the page.
keys.if_tool_missing_or_failing: Double-click Setup AI4S.bat (Windows) or Setup AI4S.command (Mac) in the archive folder. Only if that fails, give one line: node runtime/bundle/index.mjs --setup (runtime/dist/index.js on a source build), after saying how to open a terminal in the plugin folder.
keys.takes_effect: PubMed and EasyScholar keys are read on the next search. A Zotero key takes effect after the app restarts; setup_status says so.
keys.developer_only: scripts/onboard.mjs. Never mention it to a beginner.

chatgpt-desktop.label: ChatGPT desktop
chatgpt-desktop.note: Codex-based host. The in-app agent may not be able to run codex plugin marketplace add. Try the Codex plugin route when the codex CLI is available; that route is unverified inside ChatGPT desktop. Otherwise append the two servers from .mcp.json to config.toml, using absolute paths. Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml. Mac: ~/.codex/config.toml (unverified). Back up the file first, keep existing entries, and do not duplicate [mcp_servers.ai4s-literature-zotero] or [mcp_servers.ai4s-literature-fulltext]. Source args are runtime/dist/index.js and fulltext-runtime/dist/index.js, with an [mcp_servers.<name>.env] table. Verified on Windows 11 for that source shape with command node and LITERATURE_ZOTERO_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE=workbench. Archive args use runtime/bundle/index.mjs and fulltext-runtime/bundle/index.mjs and are unverified on this host. Then the user restarts the app. Skills are not loaded by this route.

codex_plugin.note: marketplace add worked in one ChatGPT desktop run; plugin add failed under @personal. Use @ai4s-literature-workbench. The full install is not confirmed. On any failure go straight to routes.mcp_config.

steps: append the two servers from .mcp.json with absolute paths
keep existing entries and do not duplicate

workbuddy.label: WorkBuddy
workbuddy.status_applies_to: routes.marketplace. The mcp.json route is separate.
workbuddy.note: Marketplace route is unverified. The ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json fallback (no leading dot; %USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\mcp.json on Windows) was verified on Windows 11: both servers load, setup_status works, install_search_helper installs uv 0.13.7, and a real PubMed search wrote report.md. Mac and the archive bundle/index.mjs paths were not part of that test.
steps: add the GitHub repository as a plugin marketplace through the WorkBuddy interface (unverified)
workbuddy.fallback: Add the two MCP servers from .mcp.json to ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json (no leading dot before workbuddy; %USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\mcp.json on Windows), using absolute paths. Keep existing servers and do not duplicate names. Source entries use runtime/dist/index.js and fulltext-runtime/dist/index.js. A release archive uses runtime/bundle/index.mjs and fulltext-runtime/bundle/index.mjs (archive paths unverified on WorkBuddy).
workbuddy.restart_note: In one run, restarting WorkBuddy did not switch on the two new custom servers in mcp.json: setup_status stayed missing although both servers started and listed their tools when run by hand (archive bundle/index.mjs paths). If setup_status is still missing after the restart, check mcp.json and node, then ask the user to enable or trust ai4s-literature-zotero and ai4s-literature-fulltext in WorkBuddy's connector settings (menu names unconfirmed). Do not report anything as working until the end check passes.

claude-desktop.label: Claude desktop Chat
claude-desktop.status_applies_to: routes.upload_plugin on Mac with v0.2.0: four skills visible and no MCP tools
claude-desktop.covers: Uploaded plugin: four skills only. Two separate .mcpb extensions: Zotero tools plus OA-first full-text fetch and PDF verification (both unverified live).
claude-desktop.note: Uploads are stored on the claude.ai account and sync across Chat, Cowork and Code. Chat ignores plugin-local MCP servers, including plugin-declared .mcpb bundles; Code loads them. The Zotero and fulltext standalone .mcpb desktop extensions are two separate installs; fulltext needs no Zotero credentials or institutional login. Never read, create, back up or edit files under ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/ as an agent: protected directory access was denied on Mac; do not retry permission requests. Never edit the Windows config on the user's behalf either.

release_archive.version_check: Read version from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Frankkk1912/ai4s-literature-workbench/main/.codex-plugin/plugin.json. The release version is the latest release tag without a leading v. Compare dotted numbers from the left; equal counts as current. Use this archive only when the release version is the same or newer and the zip is listed. If the release is older than main, or the zip is missing, use the source route and say which. Do not compare the archive's own plugin.json to the release. If the release page or API will not load, the tag is the redirect target of https://github.com/Frankkk1912/ai4s-literature-workbench/releases/latest, and the zip is listed when its name appears in SHA256SUMS.txt.
release_archive.requires: Node.js 22.13 or newer to run archive tools; not needed for skills-only Chat upload or the separate Claude Desktop .mcpb
release_archive.keys: Keys are entered through open_setup, or by double-clicking Setup AI4S.bat or Setup AI4S.command in the archive folder. scripts/onboard.mjs is not in the archive.
release_archive.note: Use the extracted folder wherever a host route names the GitHub address. Read version from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Frankkk1912/ai4s-literature-workbench/main/.codex-plugin/plugin.json on main. CI builds and checks the archive. If the latest release's version is older than version in .codex-plugin/plugin.json on main, or the zip is not listed, use the source route and say so.
release_archive.launchers: Setup AI4S.bat (Windows) and Setup AI4S.command (Mac) in the archive folder. Each runs: node runtime/bundle/index.mjs --setup. They need Node.js 22.13 or newer. On a Mac the first double-click may need right-click, Open.
release_archive.direct_download: https://github.com/Frankkk1912/ai4s-literature-workbench/releases/latest/download/<file>, for when the release page or API will not load. Check the file against SHA256SUMS.txt before use.

source.locate_plugin_root: The folder that contains scripts/bootstrap.mjs and .mcp.json. Search for it; do not guess.

rules: Route by app and entry point: claude-code is terminal only, claude-desktop-code is the desktop Code tab, claude-desktop is Chat. If plugin skills are visible but setup_status and zotero_* tools are absent and the host looks like Claude desktop Chat or cannot run commands, use the Chat skills-only route without asking which app. Ask only when genuinely unclear.
When a step fails, go to the next route for that app without asking, and say which step failed. Stop only after every route failed.
A fetch tool that only summarises a page is not enough: download the raw file or clone the repository.

Setup ends with an onboarding mention: offer only missing keys from setup_status and the Zotero add-on. When all keys are set say: All keys are set; ask for the key page any time to change one. Never press for a key, never skip the mention. Never modify protected Claude app config as an agent; the config route is user-managed and last resort only.
